The closest match is [5], which is a training-free pipeline for retrieving optimal informative subgraphs from black-box knowledge graphs. [5] It aims to optimize recall and precision for evidence subgraphs without task-specific training, using semantic anchor grouping, bubble expansion, ranking, and reasoning-aware expansion. [5]

Also close are [3] and [1]. [3] is training-free and gives query-aware retrieval guarantees for relevant subgraphs, while [1] uses a pre-trained graph foundation model and a label-free selector to find minimal, sufficient evidence subgraphs, but it is not fully training-free in the same sense as [5]. [3, 1]
